Flow.description: When a case is created through email-to-case, Case Origin will be updated to 'Email' and Brand Field will be updated based on the Case Prior Origin.

formulas.description: Set the Brand Value based on the Case Origin
formulas.name: SetTheBrand
formulas.expression: IF(TEXT({!$Record.Origin}) = 'Email - Renault','Renault Truck',IF(TEXT({!$Record.Origin}) = 'Email - Volvo', 'Volvo Truck', TEXT({!$Record.Origin})))

Flow.interviewLabel: Update Case Origin and Brand Fields On Case Create {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}
Flow.label: Update Case Origin and Brand Fields On Case Create

recordUpdates.description: Update Case Origin(Email) and Brand Field(From the Formula Resource)
recordUpdates.name: Update_Case_Origin_as_Email_and_Brand_based_on_Case_Origin
recordUpdates.label: Update Case Origin as Email and Brand based on Case Origin

start.filterFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Origin}, 'Email - Renault'), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Origin}, 'Email - Volvo') ), OR({!$Record.RecordType.DeveloperName} = 'All_Case', {!$Record.RecordType.DeveloperName} = 'VFS_Dealer') )
